message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The fact: defendant knowingly has obligation to fulfill a civil judgment, during execution he intentionally hides assets, causing judgment cannot be enforced. This is typical crime of "拒不执行判决、裁定罪" (refusal to execute judgment). In Chinese criminal law, article 311 (formerly 311) - "拒不执行判决、裁定罪". So the answer: [罪名]拒不执行判决、裁定<eoa>. Possibly also "隐匿财产" but that's part of same crime. So single crime.

Thus final answer.
